scalars.commentary_text: Yesterday (9 July 2026 · วันพฤหัสบดี), combined net was ฿77,932 ex-VAT, 4.9% above the 30-day average. MW1 was ฿36,490 (-3.3% vs its 30-day average), SE3 was ฿28,120 (+10.6% vs average), and PKT was ฿13,323 (+20.0% vs average) — all three branches within normal range of their 30-day averages, with PKT showing the largest positive swing.
